conviction_note: Near non-result: the pre-print shocks (a $33m post-tax impairment, cost guidance on track, a $295m capital return) were all disclosed on 10 Aug 2026. What is left is a 2H NIM tailwind the company and BEN's 2H already signalled, against APRA monthly data showing the home-loan book shrank in 2H at the same pace as in 1H. The findings sum to +0.4 and the scaled number is +0.33 (p_up 53 x abs 5.5). Both are small and point the same way, so there is no gap to explain.
bar: There is no sourced street EPS line. Morgans (downgrade to Hold, target $6.40, week of 6 Oct 2026) expects 'a mid-single digit decline in 2H26 earnings (ex notable costs)' on 1H cash NPAT of $176m, i.e. roughly $165-170m in 2H. Consensus FY26 EPS is about 47.7-49c (FNArena; Yahoo shows 0.49 across 12 analysts, revised down from 0.53 over 90 days). The 14-analyst target is $6.27-6.29, below the $6.49 spot. The company's own bar (1H26 outlook): 'tailwinds to margin', sub-inflation FY26 cost growth, home lending contraction easing, growth in FY27. Sources: https://www.ibtimes.com.au/boq-shares-rise-ahead-full-year-results-1876599 , https://www.fnarena.com/index.php/analysis-data/consensus-forecasts/stock-analysis/?code=BOQ , https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260422/pdf/06yqn40qfhs68p.pdf. Two partly agreeing estimate sources plus a company statement, so sizes are not capped, but the bar is loose.
filer_type_check: results: BOQ lodges full-year results (FY ends 31 Aug) and half-year results. I hunted the profit result: 2H NIM, volumes, final dividend, the capital surplus and the first FY27 outlook under CEO Rod Finch.
event_check: ASX announcement 'FY26 Results Webcast', lodged 06/10/2026 09:07 (idsId 03148739): 'BOQ will release its financial results for the full year ended 31 August 2026 on Thursday, 15 October 2026', briefing at 10:00 AEDT. https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20261006/pdf/074zbk1qbc4rz0.pdf ; archive https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=BOQ&timeframe=Y&year=2026
session_check: bmo. The webcast notice puts the briefing at 10:00 AEDT on the day, the open. All five prior results in the ASX record were lodged 08:15-08:43 Sydney (e.g. 22/04/2026 08:15 and 08:32). https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20261006/pdf/074zbk1qbc4rz0.pdf
positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 4.49% (29.6m shares) as of 2026-10-08, up from 4.23% on 10-01 (+0.26pp, building), lag 4 sessions. This is elevated for an ASX bank, and sentiment is bearish (1 Buy / 7 Hold / 6 Sell, average target below spot), so the bar is low and a crowded short is fuel against a negative. The baseline lean already carries this at +2.2. Over the lag the stock went 6.38 -> 6.69 -> 6.49; it fell 3.0% on 14 Oct with the sector (BEN -3.5%, CBA -2.2%), so nothing idiosyncratic happened into the seal. I did not size positioning as a separate finding, because it would only restate the baseline lean.

findings.finding: APRA's monthly ADI statistics show BOQ's resident housing loans fell from $52,790m (Feb 2026) to $50,731m (Aug 2026), -$2,059m or -3.9% over 2H26. That is the same pace as 1H26 (-$2,095m from Aug 2025), against the 1H26 guide that 'home lending contraction [is] easing'. Total resident deposits fell 3.1% ($68,791m to $66,648m). Two caveats: Jul-Aug flattened (Aug -$2m), and business loans rose to $15,827m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 1H26 (22 Apr 2026): retail GLA fell $1.5bn and NIM fell 3bp; the stock moved -9.08%, the worst of five observed prints. FY25 (15 Oct 2025): +1.40%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The series is public and analysts who track it would have it in the mid-single-digit 2H decline estimates. What may not be priced is the read-through to the FY27 'return to home lending growth' guide: if the market had absorbed it, consensus FY27 numbers would have been cut alongside the downgrades, and the 90-day revision visible on Yahoo (0.53 to 0.49) is roughly the size of the $33m notable item alone.
findings.independence: The company's own 1H26 deck says home lending contraction was easing (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260422/pdf/06yqnk5f5h2d6l.pdf). It cuts the other way and is not corroboration. Otherwise none.

findings.finding: Rising cash rates point to a 2H26 margin lift. BOQ's 1H26 deck lists '2H26 considerations: benefits from an increasing cash rate environment, replicating portfolio and hedging benefits, ... tailwinds from TD spreads, deposit pricing and funding mix'. Peer Bendigo & Adelaide reported a 2H26 NIM of 1.98%, up 6bp half on half, on deposit mix, TD repricing and the replicating portfolio (results 18 Aug 2026).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NIM -3bp at 1H26 -> -9.08%. NIM +10bp y/y at FY25 (1.67% vs 1.57% the half before) -> +1.40%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The company guided it and BEN printed it two months ago. If the margin lift were fully in numbers, Morgans would not still be forecasting a mid-single-digit 2H decline. It is consistent with that forecast only if volume loss (finding 1) offsets the margin gain, so the two findings net against each other and are not double-counted.
findings.independence: Bendigo FY26: https://www.businessnewsaustralia.com/articles/bendigo-bank-lifts-full-year-profit-to-530m-as-lower-cost-deposit-growth-buoys-margins.html (a different issuer, but the same proxy mechanism)

findings.finding: Capital is still in surplus and the buyback is mostly unspent. BOQ's 10 Aug release gives a pro-forma CET1 of 11.01% after the $295m return, against a 10.25-10.75% target range. The 1 Sep Appendix 3C shows only about 1.72m shares (about $11.1m) of the $196m on-market buyback bought before the results blackout. So about $185m resumes after the print, and the surplus above the range invites an upsize or a final-dividend payout at the top of 60-75%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The capital return announcement on 10 Aug 2026 is not in the results history and I did not measure its reaction. No observed result in the history carried a capital-return surprise.
findings.why_not_priced: The buyback and the CET1 are public. What is not priced is any upsize from the remaining 26-76bp above the top of the range. If the market expected one, the sell-side would not sit at 6 Sell with targets below spot. Resumed buying of about $0.7m a day against $9.6m median turnover is real but small support.
findings.independence: Appendix 3C buyback update, 1 Sep 2026: https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260901/pdf/073kc2jc49qgsd.pdf (the same issuer, a different document)

findings.finding: The 2H26 notable items and the cost outcome were pre-released on 10 Aug 2026: a $47m pre-tax ($33m post-tax) technology and asset impairment, excluded from the final dividend base, and 'Excluding this notable item, BOQ is on track to meet guidance of sub-inflation expense growth for FY26'. That removes most of the kitchen-sink and cost-miss risk at the first full-year result under CEO Rod Finch.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At 1H26, a $31m post-tax held-for-sale loss sat in statutory profit and the stock fell -9.08%, though cash earnings and NIM were the drivers.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it was disclosed two months ago and consensus EPS fell by roughly that amount over 90 days. I filed it at zero because it lands inside what the company already said. Its value is that it narrows the downside tail, not that it gives a direction.
findings.independence: Yahoo consensus FY26 EPS revision from 0.53 to 0.49 over 90 days, cited in the IBTimes and ad-hoc-news coverage: https://www.ibtimes.com.au/boq-shares-rise-ahead-full-year-results-1876599

findings.finding: The 1H26 deck warns that 'there may be further statutory impacts recognised in 2H26, upon completion' of the Challenger whole-of-loan sale, which completed 1 May 2026. The 10 Aug release did not quantify any such item, so a further statutory loss is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the same held-for-sale line as at 1H26 ($31m post-tax loss, -9.08% day, with other drivers).
findings.why_not_priced: It sits below cash earnings, has no path to the guide and is flagged as non-cash, so I sized it at a fraction.

outside_window.finding: Pace of the remaining approximately $185m on-market buyback over the next 12 months

rejected_candidates.detail: This is the bar, not a finding. It is used in 'bar' and in the why_not_priced of findings 1 and 2.

baseline_tension: Mild agreement. The lean is +2.2, driven by a 4.5% and building short, and my evidence leans faintly positive (margin tailwind, capital surplus, low sell-side bar) against a negative volume read. The findings do not beat the lean; they sit well inside it.
